'''Wol Cabassh''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] situated in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of both the [[plasma leech]] [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] [[Parasite/Legends|parasite]] and the related [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Wol Cabasshite/Legends|Wol Cabasshites]]. The latter [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Diet/Legends|fed]] on [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] and [[Metal/Legends|metals]] and [[Wol Cabasshite language|communicated]] via the use of natural [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic fields]]. Over [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], starship travel spread both the plasma [[Leech/Legends|leech]] and the Wol Cabasshites far from Wol Cabassh.

==Description==
Wol Cabassh was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|332|Wol Cabasshite}}</ref> located in the [[Wol Cabassh system/Legends|Wol Cabassh system]], a part of the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="NewTerritories" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[plasma leech]], a small [[Diet/Legends|ergovorous]] [[Parasite/Legends|parasite]] that consumed [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] and whose entire life-cycle occurred aboard [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] where it fed on power sources.<ref name="DB" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Wol Cabasshite/Legends}}
[[File:WolCabasshite-Chron.png|thumb|right|300px|The Wol Cabasshites were native to Wol Cabassh.]]
Wol Cabassh was the homeworld of the [[Wol Cabasshite/Legends|Wol Cabasshites]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="DB" /> immobile<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Ghoel}}</ref> [[Slug (creature)/Legends|slugs]]<ref name="CSWE" /> that were descended from parasites<ref name="CCG" /> and whose closest [[Gene/Legends|genetic]] relative was the plasma [[Leech/Legends|leech]]. The Wol Cabasshites could tolerate extreme [[Temperature/Legends|temperatures]] and severe variations in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] pressure and fed upon<ref name="DB" /> plasma-rich substances<ref name="CSWE" /> as well as [[Metal/Legends|metals]]. The species developed a [[Wol Cabasshite language|language]] that involved a Wol Cabasshite exuding and manipulating a natural [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic field]].<ref name="DB" />

[[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] of starship travel resulted in the spread of both the plasma leech and the Wol Cabasshites far from their homeworld and throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="DB" /> The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] eventually included a product known as [[Wol Cabasshew]]s as part of his [[interstellar garden salad]] recipe in the menu for [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on<ref name="Dex">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wol Cabassh was developed as part of the backstory for<ref name="DB" /> [[Ghoel/Legends|Ghoel]],<ref name="CCG" /> a character appearing in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] member "[[ejmacki]]" submitted an entry for Ghoel's species<ref name="DB" /> through the Hyperspace feature "[[What's The Story?]]," and it was added to the site's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] on [[February 3]], [[2006]].<ref name="What's The Story">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20060203.html|text=What's the Story, Round 4}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Wol Cabassh [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square O-6.<ref name="TEA WolCabassh" />
